5. 实现信号量计算和策略评估

Pseudocode:
class StrategyService:
    def __init__(self, config: StrategyServiceConfig):
        self._config = config
        self._signal_cache: dict[str, dict] = {}  # pair_id -> signals
        self._opportunities: list[dict] = []
    
    def on_odds_update(self, pair_id: str, venue: str, odds_data: dict):
        # 更新缓存并触发计算
        self._calculate_signals(pair_id)
        self._evaluate_strategy(pair_id)
    
    def _calculate_signals(self, pair_id: str):
        strategy = self._get_strategy_for_pair(pair_id)
        for signal_config in strategy.signals:
            signal = self._create_signal(signal_config)
            result = signal.calculate(poly_odds, orbit_odds)
            self._signal_cache[pair_id][signal.name] = result
    
    def _evaluate_strategy(self, pair_id: str):
        strategy = self._get_strategy_for_pair(pair_id)
        signals = self._signal_cache[pair_id]
        if strategy.trigger_mode == 'all':
            satisfied = all(s.satisfied for s in signals.values())
        else:
            satisfied = any(s.satisfied for s in signals.values())
        if satisfied:
            self._create_opportunity(pair_id)
    
    def get_signals(self, pair_id: str) -> dict
    def get_opportunities(self) -> list

4. 在 get_odds_service 中注册策略回调

Pseudocode:
class AppState:
    def __init__(self):
        ...
        self._strategy_config = StrategyServiceConfig(...)
        self._strategy_service = None
    
    def get_strategy_config(self) -> dict
    def update_strategy_config(self, data: dict) -> dict
    
    def get_strategy_service(self):
        if self._strategy_service is None:
            from ...strategy.service import StrategyService
            self._strategy_service = StrategyService(self._strategy_config)
            # 注册到赔率服务
            odds_service = self.get_odds_service()
            odds_service.register_strategy_callback(self._strategy_service.on_odds_update)
        return self._strategy_service
